items.text: We've hammered out a few more issues that were tripping up players in the Speedball arena.
Achievements, rewards and League Mode wins should now all be awarded correctly.
Goal keepers were being a little too active in the goal area, diving further than expected. So we have taken them back to boot camp and they should now stay guarding that goal!
See you in the arena!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/5496dd6d676649ff685b02b96e352fb8c2fa3c71.png"]
Updated localisation
Various achievements will now unlock correctly on all platforms
Pausing is now possible in all tutorials
Fixed various possible crashes
Players are no longer able to continue playing after one player has forfeit
Fixed an issue where voice over would be incorrect if a player forfeits a match
Online Rewards will now unlock immediately after completing the requirements, instead of needing an additional online match
The correct winner will now be displayed in the post-match screen
Fixed online win streak counter to display correctly
Players will no longer get stuck in the half time screen if the other player forfeits
The goalkeeper will no longer get stuck holding onto the ball
Fixed an issue where the controller disconnect message would remain on screen if Player 2’s controller was disconnected during the match end cutscene
Players will now be able to reconnect their second controller if it disconnects during the team select screen
Players will no longer T-pose when not moving
Improved Goalkeeper AI in cases where players were passing near the goal
Improved Goalkeeper AI to not dive so far away from the goal when missing a dive tackle
Fixed an issue where the play match button would become unusable if the player cancelled matchmaking during the initialising stage
Online mode ranks will now display correctly when rank changes
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when launching in offline mode
Player 2 will now see their own team, during half time team management and be able to switch their own tactics
Fixed an issue where some save data would be lost after completing League Mode for the third time
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if all players had a “Critical” injury
League Mode rewards will now be correctly awarded if you win the championship match after finishing 2nd place in the leader boarded
If you experience any further issues, please contact our Help Centre.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1795190/Speedball/"] For all the latest news and updates be sure to follow Speedball on all our social channels: X, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
We have launched hotfix 1.1.5.0 on Speedball.
In addition to the fixes we have added a further zoom on the camera for getting even closer to the brutal action.
A full list of fixes can be found here: http://reb.to/SpeedballPatchNotes
Thank you to all players who reported issues with the game difficulty not feeling correct, after investigation we found that difficulty settings weren't always applied.

Starting matches after todays patch you should find that Beginner and Easy will now feel like a welcome step into the arena, and Brutal and Hard will be less considerate to the broken bones of your players.
We look forward to seeing your heated matches to become League Mode champion, in whichever difficulty you chose!
See you in the arena!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/dc36d1b4eee03047d12ed5266fd5389e8f68bff9.jpg"]
Fixed an issue where getting jump tackled could get the ball stuck in the air
Improved performance when switching to “Online” tab
Adjusted detection for the achievement “No Sick Days” to unlock correctly
Achievements “I can do this with my eyes closed”, “Clean Sheet”, “Goal? Never Heard of Them”, “Comeback Kid” and “Savaged” will now unlock correctly on all platforms
Fixed an issue where players would be stuck in a T-pose and not move
Difficulty selected will now be correctly applied
Team stats will now be displayed correctly if either team forfeits
Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if your team became fully depleted
Updated localisation
Fixed an issue where your armour style would sometimes change to your previous opponents
Fixed an issue where team stats would not update after a match
“Team Tactics” and “Line Up” will now change correctly after half time
Matches will no longer display as a draw if either player forfeits
Improved selection in the arena selection screen
Fixed an issue around changing a team’s name after changing game language
Fixed an issue around changing a team’s name after reconnecting to the internet
Team names will no longer generate blank using the randomise option
Fixed an issue where custom match length timer settings would not apply correctly
Fixed an issue where “Team Tactics” would not change correctly after half time
Incorrect team badges will no longer be shown
Fixed an issue that prevented accepting an Invite a Friend match invite while already playing a match
Disabling Half Time via “Edit Match” custom settings will now correctly apply
Speedball Stadium overview will now only display the correct number of Multiplier hoops
Toggling “Score Limit” and “Match Timer” on and off will now display the correct description
Fixed an issue where pressing buttons too quickly on the recruitment screen would cause the selection menu to not display correctly
Fixed an issue where returning to the “Select New Player” screen would cause the background to display incorrectly
Players will now be able to play as a League Mode team who have already won the championship
Players will now wear their own helmets in the final cutscene of League Mode
Points table will now reset correctly after completing League Mode and starting again
Selecting “Match History” on the “Next Match” screen will now function as intended
If you experience any further issues, please contact our Help Centre.

notes.title: We have just patched Speedball with a brand new update.

items.text: This update builds on community feedback from you, our players!
Highlights
Arena selection in League Mode
More competitive AI
Improved tutorials
Added impactful VFX
Since the September Speedball Update we have been absorbing everything said in our recent Player Survey, Steam Forums and our dedicated Discord server.
One of these suggestions was to include the "Speedball Stadium" (our tribute to the past) in our League Mode - which offers a classic Speedball layout.
Another chance for you to test yourself against our Developers!
Friday 31st October 3pm - 5pm GMT
Play Online Mode between these hours and you will face down against the fiercest foes from Rebellion!
Improved Tutorial
Changed requirements for online unlockable
Improved player AI
Goalkeepers will now react more appropriately
Harder difficulty AI will now try to score more goals
Added new VFX for collisions and player switching
Added arena selection for League Mode, now choose between Normal, Brutal and Speedball Stadium
Fixed an issue where players were not gaining form in League Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/15ddabead696a0cd0997ae3315479b94f5119a15.png"]

Ahead of Play vs Devs on Friday afternoon, we are releasing our latest update for Speedball.
With a fresh new look, and a host of new changes and features, it's time to get stuck back into the arena and become Speedball champion once again.
Starting in this update, you can now invite a Steam friend to play against in Speedball.
Choose from a selection of pre-made teams, select your arena and you're ready to go!
If you want to have a longer match with a friend or vs the CPU. You can now customise the match!
Boost the time to a lengthy 15 minutes, or increase the damage taking to a whopping 400%, and play the most brutal game of Speedball yet!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/306a9a8e0e6410224a0b51266ee0dc74f00aedbd.png"]
We have so many new arenas in this update, filling out the league mode roster with each team having their own arena with unique styles.
Teams in League mode and quickplay now have a trait to assist them in home arena games. Is there a team you have yet to try? Maybe give Rage 2000 a season with their increased damage on tackles!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/15ddabead696a0cd0997ae3315479b94f5119a15.png"]
New UI - Front End and Match HUD have been updated
Invite friend - You can now make a private lobby for you and a friend to play Speedball with your rules!
New Tutorial Scenarios
Various AI Improvements
Two new teams available in Quick Play and Online Customisation options,
Ms Snuffle Piglets & The Judges
New Themed Arenas - BioPrime Lab, Favela and Subway Abandoned
New Arena Hazards - Ball Electrifier & Rebound Bumper
Reworked some arenas to have less hazards
These arenas now have a "Brutal" version, with all the hazards still included, for maximum injury opportunities!
Added Speedball Stadium
This new arena layout some dedicated fans may recognise from Speedball 2.
Added the Practice Stadium
This arena is Speedball at it's simplest, just two teams, two goals and a ball!

items.text: In Speedball’s League Mode, 10 teams compete over a season to be crowned champions. To take your team of rookies to the top, you will need to grow a squad of up to 18 all-stars, and manage who you play, bench or rest for each game. Effectively rotating your players throughout the season will be key to managing the fatigue of your players and preventing injuries.

Pick your best team using each player’s set of unique stats (including shot power, speed, durability etc) and traits (such as pyromaniac, rioter, star shooter and pitcher). You will need to draft in new players throughout the season to bolster your ranks and replace your losses – remember, there are no-holds barred in the arena!

notes.title: Get ready for EVEN MORE DANGER

items.text: In the most dangerous game of Speedball!
Take a defensive formation as KillTek's weapons factory is a prime area for experimentation,
And your team are the test subjects!
With the KillTek update you will find three brand new arenas:
The Armoury
Grid HQ
Cryogenesis Grounds
In The Armoury and Grid HQ you will find your team surrounded by KillTek's latest creations, the KillTek TripWire and the thunderous Thumpers!
You will need your most nimble players to evade these dangers, so get warmed up to dash and jump around these menacing sports arenas!

Despite the cold weather, we've also really been hankering for some ice cream. Something tells us we'll hearing a lot more about frozen treats in the coming future...
